Format writes a fixed sector set (MBR + 2 headers + 2x entry arrays), independent of device size -> O(1) vs device size.

Resolved (2026-08-07 backfill). Spec describes actual per-sector read (33 round-trips @512B / 5 @4096B), O(1) in device size. Batching into one multi-sector read is a deliberate future perf task, not drift.
Write/read share identical LBA<->sector math; round-trip offsets identical. No automated test (parked #1).
CRC-corrupt AND signature-damaged primary both fall back to backup transparently. No automated test (parked #1).
ASCII names round-trip UTF-8->UTF-16LE->UTF-8. No automated test (parked #1).

parked_non_drift.notes: SC-001/002/003 behaviorally aligned but have zero automated verification. Test-coverage gap, not a spec-text contradiction; SC remain the target and are not weakened. Adding tests edits src/Cargo.toml, out of scope for a spec-sync apply.

Read assumes primary entry array at LBA 2; every Certus-written GPT uses LBA 2 (write_gpt :185). Externally-authored GPT with different offset read incorrectly. Documented in spec Implementation Notes; future robustness change.

If /dev/urandom cannot be opened, generate_guid returns an all-zero GUID except version/variant bits. Documented in spec Implementation Notes as known behavior, not an FR-level guarantee. Not a spec<->impl contradiction.
